field.name: Name
hint.price: Leave empty to hide the price from clients
hint.buffer: Time to prepare the room after the visit
hint.clinicTimezone: Used for offices without their own time zone
hint.minLead: How long before a visit clients can still book
hint.slotStep: Start times offered: every N minutes
hint.maxAdvance: How far ahead clients can book
setup.title: Getting started
setup.intro: Three steps and the calendar will show free time — the same the booking form will offer.
setup.dentist: Add a dentist, choose their services and working hours
calendar.title: Availability
calendar.hint: Free start times the booking form offers: working hours, exceptions, appointments and the minimum notice are taken into account. The number shows how many dentists are free.
dentists.title: Dentists
dentists.priorityHint: Drag to set priority. When a client books “any dentist”, the free dentist highest in the list gets the appointment.
dentist.noServicesYet: No services yet. Add them first:
dentist.weeklyHoursHint: Working hours repeat every week, in the office's local time. A shift that ends earlier than it starts runs past midnight.
dentist.noHours: No working hours — the dentist gets no bookings.
dentist.overlap: Shifts overlap. A dentist cannot work two shifts at once, even in different offices.
exceptions.title: Time off and extra time
exceptions.hint: One-off changes to the weekly schedule for the next four months.
exceptions.extraLong: Extra time — open time outside the schedule
services.title: Services
offices.title: Offices
staff.title: Staff
staff.addHint: Set a first password and give it to the person. Administrators manage all clinic data; front desk only views it.
settings.title: Clinic settings
settings.requiresConfirmation: Online bookings need confirmation by the clinic
settings.requiresConfirmationHint: Off: a booking is confirmed right after the client enters the SMS code. On: it waits until the dentist or the front desk confirms it.
website.title: Booking form on your website
website.intro: The key connects the booking form to your clinic. It works only on the websites listed next to it — requests from other sites are refused.
website.originsHint: Full address with https://, one per line, e.g. https://example.com
website.revokeConfirm: Revoke the key? The booking form with it stops working at once.
